notes.title: V1.4版本更新（V1.4 version update）
notes.notes:
1、每位玩家都是造墓者与盗墓者，可以参与墓制作，或破解他人制作的墓。
2、触发墓中的陷阱，玩家的骸骨会消亡。
3、找到墓中的棺椁或者宝箱，可以获得墓中骸骨及骸骨装甲，用于复活。
4、除了玩家制作的墓，场景中也会存在一些野生的墓，用于突破。
5、地形进行的较大的升级，扩大了非常多。
6、玩家人物进行了升级，后续还会有更多人物退出。
7、每位玩家根据造墓称号的不同，会获得不同数量的造墓材料，每日更新。称号级别越高，获得的材料越多。

1. Each player is a tomb maker and tomb raider, and can participate in tomb making or decipher tombs made by others.
2. Trigger the trap in the tomb, and the player's bones will disappear.
3. Find the coffin or treasure chest in the tomb to obtain the bones and bone armor in the tomb, which can be used for resurrection.
4. In addition to the tombs created by players, there will also be some wild tombs in the scene for breakthroughs.
5. The terrain has undergone significant upgrades and has expanded significantly.
6. The player characters have been upgraded, and there will be more characters exiting in the future.
7. Each player will receive a different amount of tomb building materials based on the different tomb building titles, which are updated daily. The higher the title level, the more materials will be obtained.

notes.title: V1.3 version update
notes.notes:
1. Tomb raiding gains items and increases skeletal equipment.
2. The equipment is mainly divided into head armor, chest armor, shoulder armor, knee protection, leg protection, and wrist armor.
3. Each piece of equipment is divided into multiple levels, and the proportion of damage reduction varies depending on the equipment worn by the skeleton.
4. Add the protagonist of tomb raiding.
5. Add an automatic refresh mechanism for graves.
6. Different levels of equipment increase edge glow.
7. Increase aperture flicker at the feet of different levels of bones.
